title: LLMs Can Unlearn Refusal with Only 1,000 Benign Samples
reasoning: The paper investigates the technical vulnerability of LLM safety alignment through a 'refusal unlearning' technique. While it addresses 'harmlessness' and 'safety alignment', it focuses on the mechanics of sequence memorization and refusal prefixes rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or specific ethical and moral reasoning frameworks.
